turns.sql:
WITH cust_totals AS (
  SELECT c.customer_id,
         SUM(ft.transaction_amount) AS total_amount
  FROM Customers c
  JOIN Accounts a ON a.customer_id = c.customer_id
  JOIN Financial_Transactions ft ON ft.account_id = a.account_id
  GROUP BY c.customer_id
),
avg_total AS (
  SELECT AVG(total_amount) AS avg_amount FROM cust_totals
)
SELECT c.customer_first_name,
       c.customer_last_name,
       a.account_name
FROM Customers c
JOIN Accounts a ON a.customer_id = c.customer_id
JOIN cust_totals ct ON ct.customer_id = c.customer_id
JOIN avg_total at ON ct.total_amount > at.avg_amount
ORDER BY c.customer_last_name, c.customer_first_name;
